assets.scope: Measurements and QA composites only; not approval.
assets.name: ma11-drinking-fountain-v1.png

observations: Native 1341 x 1173 RGBA, alpha 0 to 255; actual paper and dark composites have clean edges without the raw-preview colour fringe.
At 820 px tall, apparatus and water stream read clearly, but the red model overlay visibly misses the painted arc.
No people, text, logos or faces. Native dimensions preserved. No production image edits outside built-in imagegen.

result: Fountain candidate held after two attempts: endpoints differ by 71 px and the equal-scale profile misses by up to 119.72 px against a 13.38 px tolerance. No public PNG delivered. A curve fit alone cannot make unequal endpoint heights teach the specified model. Root must resolve the geometry before build. The w14 high hammock remains a static join plate only; w16 end plate is in progress.
sourceReview: Source findings remain as recorded in the learning review. Artwork QA does not clear speech or playback.
